XMLDB.COMMENT: XMLDB file for AI Knowledge Check module

FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: Course ID

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Activity name

FIELD.NAME: intro
FIELD.COMMENT: Activity introduction

FIELD.NAME: grade
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum grade (point value)

FIELD.NAME: maxattempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Max attempts (0=unlimited)

FIELD.NAME: questioncount
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of questions

FIELD.NAME: passinggrade
FIELD.COMMENT: Passing grade percentage

FIELD.NAME: completionallcorrect
FIELD.COMMENT: Complete when all correct

FIELD.NAME: completionpassgrade
FIELD.COMMENT: Complete when passing grade achieved

FIELD.NAME: ccemail
FIELD.COMMENT: CC email for notifications

FIELD.NAME: voiceoverenabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether voiceover is enabled (1=yes, 0=no)

FIELD.NAME: voicelanguage
FIELD.COMMENT: Voice language code

FIELD.NAME: voicegender
FIELD.COMMENT: Voice gender

FIELD.NAME: voicestyle
FIELD.COMMENT: Voice style/ID

FIELD.NAME: videourl
FIELD.COMMENT: YouTube video URL for video gate

FIELD.NAME: videorequirement
FIELD.COMMENT: Video watch requirement: none, seconds, full

FIELD.NAME: videominseconds
FIELD.COMMENT: Minimum seconds to watch when requirement=seconds

FIELD.NAME: showvideoduringquiz
FIELD.COMMENT: Show video above questions while student is answering (1=yes, 0=no)

FIELD.NAME: showchapterstamps
FIELD.COMMENT: Show clickable chapter timestamp link per question (1=yes, 0=no)

FIELD.NAME: audiourl
FIELD.COMMENT: Audio file URL for audio gate

FIELD.NAME: audiorequirement
FIELD.COMMENT: Audio listen requirement: none, seconds, full

FIELD.NAME: audiominseconds
FIELD.COMMENT: Minimum seconds to listen when requirement=seconds

FIELD.NAME: imageurl
FIELD.COMMENT: Image URL for image gate — teacher pastes URL or stores base64 data URL from Imagen 4 generation. When set, students must acknowledge the image before quiz starts.

FIELD.NAME: aftercompletion
FIELD.COMMENT: What happens after student completes the quiz: restart=allow retake, lock=prevent further attempts

FIELD.NAME: sourcecontext
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON-encoded source context from the original generate call (topics, userQuestions, textSources, workplaceContext, education settings) — used by Regenerate Questions to keep regenerated questions grounded in the same source material. Added v1.5.95 (FIX-KC-REGEN-GROUNDING).

FIELD.NAME: surveymode
FIELD.COMMENT: When 1, the activity runs as a survey (no correct/wrong answers, scale-based responses). Added v1.5.126.

FIELD.NAME: surveyscale
FIELD.COMMENT: Survey response scale key, e.g. likert5agree, likert5sat, yesno. Only used when surveymode=1. Added v1.5.126. FIX-KC-XMLDB-DEFAULT (v1.5.150): was DEFAULT empty string, which Moodle rejects for a CHAR NOT NULL column and silently rewrote to NULL, emitting an XMLDB debugging warning. An empty string was never a valid scale key anyway - mod_form defaults to likert5agree and every code path falls back to it - so the real default is declared here.

FIELD.NAME: audiodata
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of base64 encoded audio for each answer

FIELD.NAME: mappingtopic
FIELD.COMMENT: Topic text for question mapping export

FIELD.NAME: mappingcriteria
FIELD.COMMENT: Performance criteria for question mapping export

FIELD.NAME: timestamp_seconds
FIELD.COMMENT: Video timestamp in seconds for chapter stamp link (null if not set)

FIELD.NAME: imageurl
FIELD.COMMENT: Image URL for this question — paste URL or base64 data URL generated by Imagen 4 Ultra. Shown above question text when imageenabled=1.

FIELD.NAME: imageenabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether to display an image above this question (1=yes, 0=no)

FIELD.NAME: answer5
FIELD.COMMENT: Fifth answer option for 5-point survey scales (e.g. Likert 5-point). Null for standard 4-option MCQ questions. Added v1.5.126.

FIELD.NAME: questiontype
FIELD.COMMENT: Question type: scale (default MCQ/survey scale question) or freetext (open-ended comment box). Added v1.5.127.

FIELD.NAME: questionvideourl
FIELD.COMMENT: Per-question video URL. Added v1.5.120.

FIELD.NAME: questionvideoenabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the per-question video is shown (1=yes,0=no). Added v1.5.120.

FIELD.NAME: questionaudiourl
FIELD.COMMENT: Per-question audio URL. Added v1.5.120.

FIELD.NAME: questionaudioenabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the per-question audio is shown (1=yes,0=no). Added v1.5.120.

FIELD.NAME: answers
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON encoded answers

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=in progress, 1=completed

FIELD.NAME: questions
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON encoded questions

FIELD.NAME: audiodata
FIELD.COMMENT: Base64 encoded audio
